This rented plot is small, and here in Mwanza I depend on root crops because they manage better when rains are not perfect. I will keep my costs low, so I will not buy much chemical input, but I can use some manure if I get it and rely mostly on family work. I will plant the seed I know locally and intercrop as usual, with no irrigation because I do not have that setup.
